title: The special-order result names the vendor of the most recent delivery
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Vendors {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B} (for example the first and the second vendor in Parts → Vendors) exist.
  • Part number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SOTWO-01) was ordered as a special order from {Vendor-A} on work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440), and later from {Vendor-B} on work order {Work-order-2} (for example S2-15441), both at {Location-A}.
  • Within the last 12 months, {Location-A} received the {Vendor-B} order first and the {Vendor-A} order last, so {Vendor-A} made the most recent delivery.
  • Part number {Part-A} is not an inventory part at {Location-A}.
  • Work order {Work-order-3} (for example S2-15442) is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer, with a line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL two vendors line").
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  2. Open {Work-order-3}.
  3. In the Parts row of {Line-1} click + Add Part.
  4. In New Part Request, type {Part-A} in Part Number.
  5. Read the special-order result offered for {Part-A} and its source.
  6. Close the dialog without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The special-order result for {Part-A} shows its source as "Part Library · {Vendor-A}", the vendor of the most recent delivery. It does not name {Vendor-B}, although {Vendor-B} was ordered from last.
  • Step 6: The dialog closes and nothing is added to {Line-1}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S12-R14b, S12-R14a, S12-R14, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.1 (While active: GREASETUBE is found), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 2). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R14b: “When more than one vendor delivered that number in the last 12 months, the result names the vendor of the most recent delivery.”
  • S12-R14a: “A special-order lookup result is a part number this location received from a vendor on a special-order line (a received line with no inventory part, and not a core) in the last 12 months.”
  • S12-R14: “A special-order lookup result shows its source as "Part Library · {vendor}".”
